{{Quote|Want to see my impression of a Geonosian?''"<br />"''What, plummeting to the ground in a spray of bugsplatter after I put a round through you?''"<br />"''You’re so masterful.''"<br />"''I’m so a sergeant, Private&mdash;|[[Fi Skirata|Fi]] and clone paratrooper [[Barlex]]|<ref name="RC: TC" />}}
'''Clone paratroopers''', also known as '''airborne troopers''', '''sky troopers''', and sometimes referred to as '''"Beehive" paratroopers''' due to the shape of their [[Helmet/Legends|helmets]], were elite [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] who specialized in high-altitude drops and aerial operations, using special equipment and [[Phase II clone trooper armor|armor]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].

==Description==
===Overview===
[[Cloning/Legends|Clone]] airborne [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]],<ref name="Hasbro Airborne">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: 30th Anniversary Collection|pack=#07: Airborne Trooper|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TAC07airborne.asp}}</ref> also called clone paratroopers<ref name="Sideshow 2ndAC" /> and sky troopers,<ref name="RC: TC" /> were specialized and elite [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] that utilized specialized equipment to carry out high-altitude drops,<ref name="Sideshow 2ndAC" /> aerial [[Scout/Legends|reconnaissance]], and aerial combat<ref name="TCSWE" /> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="Sideshow 2ndAC" /> Many units deployed clone paratroopers during the war, including the [[187th Legion/Legends|187th Legion]],<ref name="Hasbro 187th">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars Unleashed|packtype=Battle Pack|pack=187th Legion Troopers (Ultimate Battles)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/sw07unlUB-187.asp}}</ref> [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Keller's unit]],<ref name="Keller" /> the [[Sky Corps]],<ref name="GGAR">{{InsiderCite|84|Guide to the Grand Army of the Republic}}</ref> and the [[212th Attack Battalion/Legends|212th Attack Battalion]].<ref name="212th Hasbro">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Clone Wars (toy line)|pack=212th Attack Battalion Clone Troopers And Jet Backpacks|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TCWdlxCloneJets.asp}}</ref> Some units were entirely composed of clone airborne troopers, including the [[2nd Airborne Company/Legends|2nd Airborne Company]]<ref name="Sideshow 2ndAC" /> and its sub-unit [[Parjai Squad]],<ref name="RC: TC" /> as well as a [[Unidentified clone airborne division|clone airborne division]] of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]].<ref name="Anakin airborne" />

===Equipment and armor===
[[File:Swi_skycorps.png|thumb|left|260px|Clone paratroopers used winged jet backpacks to conduct their airborne operations.]]
Towards the start of the war, clone paratroopers wore standard [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]].<ref name="212th Hasbro" /> As the war progressed and [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II clone trooper armor]] was introduced, paratroopers began wearing standard Phase II armor,<ref name="GGAR" /> as well as a specialized, heavy variant that came equipped with<ref name="Sideshow 2ndAC" /> a beehive-shaped [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]], which gave airborne troopers the nickname "Beehive" paratroopers.<ref name="2005 mania">{{SWArchive|url=welcome/about/news/f20051223/index.html|text=''Star Wars:'' The Best of 2005}} {{1stID|"Beehive" paratrooper}}</ref> Both the specialized helmet and its [[Armor/Legends|armor]] were designed to withstand high-altitude drops.<ref name="Sideshow 2ndAC" /> For the purposes of their drops and aerial operations, clone paratroopers utilized [[winged jet backpack]]s as part of their standard kits.<ref name="TCSWE" /> They also wore<ref name="Sideshow 2ndAC" /> [[Kama/Legends|kamas]], [[ARC command sash]]es,<ref name="RotS VD">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> and were often equipped with various pouches and bags.<ref name="SWE3" /> 

Paratrooper armor could be customized to denote rank and unit affiliation, as was the case with the 2nd Airborne [[Company/Legends|Company's]] [[Color/Legends|orange]] stripes.<ref name="Sideshow 2ndAC" /> Some paratroopers customized their armor further, including clone [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Keller (clone commander)|Keller]], who equipped [[Gender/Legends|his]] armor with a white [[Cloak/Legends|cloak]].<ref name="Keller" /> [[MEC trooper]]s were known to use clone paratrooper helmets.<ref name="BF: ES">''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron]]''</ref> Paratroopers were also armed with different [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]], including<ref name="SWE3" /> the [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]] [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifle]], the [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]] [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbine]], one or two [[DC-17 hand blaster/Legends|DC-17 hand blasters]],<ref name="RotS VD" /> and a [[Scope/Legends|scoped]] [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]].<ref name="Hasbro sky trooper">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Movie Heroes|pack=Clone Trooper with Jetpack & Firing Missiles|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/mh11-clone_trooper.asp}}</ref> At least one clone paratrooper wielded the [[E-Web heavy repeating blaster/Legends|E-Web heavy repeating blaster]] during the Clone Wars.<ref name="EGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> Clone paratroopers who trained as [[Clone sharpshooter/Legends|clone snipers]] used the [[DC-15x sniper rifle/Legends|DC-15x sniper blaster rifle]], [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn]] [[V-1 thermal detonator]]s, and [[Autoturret/Legends|autoturrets]].<ref name="BF2" />

==History==
===Clone Wars===
{{Quote|Nice of you to join us, Omega, and may I be the first to say that you look like a bunch of complete prats?|Clone paratrooper Barlex greets Omega Squad|<ref name="RC: TC" />}}
[[File:Clone_paratroopers_EGTW.jpg|thumb|right|300px|A squad of clone paratroopers storm a Separatist-held world during the Clone Wars.]]
Clone airborne troopers were active as early as [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="21 BBY date">''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]'' places the interaction between [[Barlex]] and [[Omega Squad]] 470 [[Standard day/Legends|days]] after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], which takes place after the start of [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. Given that ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' defines a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Standard year/Legends|standard year]] as 368 days, the events must therefore occur in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].</ref> where members of the 2nd Airborne Company's Parjai [[Squad/Legends|Squad]], including their senior [[Non-commissioned officer/Legends|non-commissioned officer]] [[Barlex]], interacted with the members of [[Omega Squad]]&mdash;while under orders to drop them off on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gaftikar]], before leaving to fight the Separatists on [[Mirial/Legends|Mirial]].<ref name="RC: TC" /> Clone paratroopers continued to see deployment towards the end of the war, and saw action during the [[Battle of Toola]],<ref name="Keller" /> the [[Battle of Mygeeto]],<ref name="BF2" /> and the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]].<ref name="Hasbro 187th" /> The [[212th Attack Battalion/Legends|212th Attack Battalion's]] 2nd Airborne also deployed airborne troopers from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]], for the [[Battle of Utapau/Legends|Battle of Utapau]] after [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] was discovered there.<ref name="SWE3" />

===Rise of the Empire===
{{Quote|Did you find Kenobi?''"<br />"''Sir&hellip; No one could have survived that fall.|Commander Cody and an airborne trooper|<ref name="SWE3" />}}
[[File:212th-control-Utapau.png|thumb|left|300px|A clone paratrooper reports to Commander [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] following the Battle of Utapau.]]
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] executed [[Order 66/Legends|Clone Protocol 66]] which identified all [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] as traitors to the Republic. Shortly after, [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], now [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vader, was sent to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on Coruscant to [[Death/Legends|kill]] all of the Jedi located there. He was accompanied by his clone trooper unit known as the 501st Legion,<ref name="SWE3" /> including an elite [[Division/Legends|division]] of clone paratroopers.<ref name="Anakin airborne" /> The 2nd Airborne Company and Parjai Squad followed the order as well on Utapau, where they failed to [[Death/Legends|kill]] and find their [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] General, [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].<ref name="SWE3" /> 

Following the [[Declaration of a New Order|rise]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], all clone troopers were turned into [[clone stormtrooper]]s of the new [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]], including clone paratroopers who became members of the new Imperial regime.<ref name="Sideshow 2ndAC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Clone paratroopers first appeared in {{Film|III}}, a [[2005]] film written and directed by [[George Lucas]].<ref name="SWE3" />
